chapters.summary: John declares the Word of life, emphasizing the joy of fellowship with God, and points to the necessity of confessing sin and being cleansed.
keyPoints: The Word of life existed from the beginning, and the apostles saw it with their own eyes and proclaimed it.
Fellowship with God requires walking in the light; we must not deceive ourselves by claiming to be without sin.
Confessing our sins brings forgiveness, and through Jesus' blood we are cleansed from all unrighteousness.
chapters.application: Examine your words and actions each day; when you fall short, confess openly to God, experience his forgiveness and cleansing, and be restored to close fellowship with him and with others.

chapters.summary: This chapter urges believers to walk in the light in fellowship with God, hold fast to the true teaching, and be on guard against the lies of antichrists.
keyPoints: Jesus Christ is our advocate and atoning sacrifice; when we sin, we are to confess it to him.
To keep the Lord's word is to love God; loving our brother means walking in the light, while hating our brother means remaining in darkness.
In the last days antichrists have appeared; believers are to hold fast to the truth they heard from the beginning and abide in the Lord.
chapters.application: Examine your words and actions each day, and when you sin, openly ask the Lord for forgiveness. Prove that you walk in the light through real acts of love toward your brothers and sisters, refuse to love the world, and do the will of God alone.

chapters.summary: This chapter emphasizes our identity as children of God and a holy life, showing that righteous living and love for one another are the clear evidence of true faith.
keyPoints: God has given us the honored status of being called his children, though the world does not know us.
Whoever abides in Christ does not go on sinning; living righteously is the true mark of a genuine believer.
Loving one another is a command; hating a brother is like murder, and love must be shown through action.
themes: Righteous Living and Freedom from Sin
chapters.application: As children of God, let us live out holiness and love. Each day, take real action to care for those around you in need, bearing witness to what we believe through sincere love.

chapters.summary: This chapter teaches believers to discern true and false spirits, for love comes from God; we are to love one another, because God is love.
keyPoints: Test the spirits to see whether they are from God, for false prophets have gone out into the world.
Everyone who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God; whoever does not confess this is not.
God is love, and we love one another because he first loved us.
chapters.application: In your daily life, treat others with love, and carefully discern what you hear and believe. Because God loved us first, we are able to love.

chapters.summary: 1 John chapter 5 teaches believers to believe that Jesus is the Christ, to live a life of loving one another, and to be assured that they possess eternal life.
keyPoints: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and whoever loves God ought also to love his brother.
It is our faith that overcomes the world, a faith grounded in the truth that Jesus is the Son of God.
God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son; we ought to know that we have eternal life.
chapters.application: Remind yourself each day that through faith in Jesus you already have eternal life; treat others with love and live out a victorious life.
